decisions.decision: Built the aitell anti-AI-tell production pipeline: orchestrator (tools/aitell-pipeline.cjs) + new stylometry module (tools/ai-stylometry.cjs) + PRODUCTION-PIPELINE.md, wired into bin/ai.cjs (aitell + taste cmds) and npm scripts
decisions.why: Unified the 4 separate anti-AI-tell tools behind one command that inspects every production step in 3 cheapest-first stages: (1) deterministic corpus = the ONLY blocking stage (ai-tell-lint for text, ai-sheen-lint for image prompts), (2) stylometry = advisory multi-signal score 0-100 (sentence/paragraph uniformity, n-gram repetition, connective+hedge density, list rigidity, opening repetition; language-aware en vs cjk), (3) LLM naturalness judge = advisory opt-in via --judge. Stylometry is advisory-only by design because perplexity/burstiness-style metrics false-positive on strong + non-native writing (would punish our zh/ja/th copy). Verified discrimination: AI-ish text scored 63-85/100, natural human text 0/100, TASTE.md 7/100 (proves it's human-voiced). Fixed a real bug: stylometry must strip <style>/<script>/<svg> CONTENTS for HTML or inline CSS poisons the n-gram signal. Exit code only changes on Stage 1 block; advisory stages never coerce. Both new docs added to ai-tell EXEMPT_FILES (they quote bans to teach) and written with zero em-dashes.

ai-tell.fact: Research finding (Pangram 2025 + stylometry papers): perplexity & burstiness are NOT reliable AI-detection gates — they false-positive on strong human writing (low-perplexity classics) and systematically bias against non-native/ESL writers (lower perplexity by nature), which is dangerous for our ZH/JA/TH copy. Many models (Gemini/Claude) don't expose token probs anyway. State of the art = (1) multi-signal feature stylometry (F1 0.94 vs perplexity-alone) not any single metric, (2) deep-learning/LLM judge trained on human-vs-AI pairs with ACTIVE LEARNING (self-improves from flagged examples — our mycelium loop already fits this), (3) for REDUCTION: intentional imperfection + specific voice + concrete detail beats synonym-swapping (which degrades quality). Design rule: use statistical signals as ADVISORY warnings only, never as the hard block; the block stays on deterministic corpus patterns + the LLM judge.
Layout linter emoji detection must exclude monochrome dingbat UI glyphs (close-glyph U+2715, check U+2713, etc); only colour emoji are the AI-build tell. Require VS16 (U+FE0F) for BMP-range symbols.

A shared :root design-token refactor looked tempting but is UNSAFE: 79 token names carry conflicting values across pages (--gold is #ffd700 on 41 pages, #d4af37 on 15), so consolidation would silently recolour dozens of pages.
Guild headline took 3 PRs (#84-86) and emblem 5 (#79-83) because visual bugs only surfaced on the user's phone. Fix = tools/render-risk-lint.cjs static gate, not more screenshot attempts.

Learning systems go 'silent' across chat windows NOT because they break, but because nothing re-invokes them in a fresh session (no git hooks installed; they only run on npm build/dev). Root cause = session-survival, not code. Fix = one idempotent heartbeat command that pings+exercises every tracked system, wired into session start so a cold session cannot forget it.

SOLVED: learning-system survival. Built tools/heartbeat.cjs (node bin/ai.cjs pulse) + tools/install-hooks.cjs (node bin/ai.cjs hooks). brief auto-pulses; post-commit hook re-pulses every commit; hooks installer points core.hooksPath at .husky so tracked hooks fire WITHOUT Husky. Result: learning-loop silent count 9->0, self-sustaining. Fresh sessions: run 'node bin/ai.cjs hooks' once (in playbook session-start).
[collab/strengthen] on infra problems, check hook activation state first

[collab-observer/re-fix-loop] Before shipping any "guild" change, run: node bin/ai.cjs preship public/guild/brightinside/index.html  (visual/render-risk + asset gates catch the bugs that caused the re-fix loops (#79-86)) (observed: 6 fix(guild) commits in last 60 — work shipped, broke, got re-fixed repeatedly)
